title: #358 Different Attitudes toward Money
prompt: Some think it is better to enjoy your money when you earn it, while others think it is better to save it for some time in the future. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some think it is better to enjoy your money when you earn it, while others think it is better to save it for some time in the future.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Spending money helps people enjoy their life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spending money helps people enjoy their life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Saving money helps people feel safe.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Saving money helps people feel safe.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that saving money is better than spending it all immediately.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that saving money is better than spending it all immediately.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay explains that saving money helps people achieve bigger goals later in life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay explains that saving money helps people achieve bigger goals later in life.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that spending money when earned is beneficial because it improves immediate happiness and quality of life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that spending money when earned is beneficial because it improves immediate happiness and quality of life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay supports this view by stating that spending money helps people feel good and improves their daily life through social activities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay supports this view by stating that spending money helps people feel good and improves their daily life through social activities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Saving money is crucial for achieving major life objectives, as demonstrated by the need for careful planning, such as saving for a house deposit.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Saving money is crucial for achieving major life objectives, as demonstrated by the need for careful planning, such as saving for a house deposit.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, having savings is vital for coping with unexpected and costly emergencies, thereby preventing people from incurring debt and providing a strong safety net.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, having savings is vital for coping with unexpected and costly emergencies, thereby preventing people from incurring debt and providing a strong safety net.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?

faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.
